title: How can AI be a bubble when everyone is convinced it’s one?
summary: I scroll through Reddit and post after post calls AI a bubble. I open Bloomberg or NYT and read an article about the AI bubble. I go out to dinner with friends and they’re convinced AI is a bubble. My favorite podcasters and YouTubers hem and haw about the AI bubble.It appears the entire world is convinced AI is a bubble. If this is the prevailing sentiment, why would this not be priced in?I thought the hallmarks of a bubble was that it by and large wasn’t the prevailing sentiment and wasn’t expected.submitted by/u/betabot[link][comments]
